thread:
liz: FYI - hit a nasty retry parity bug between REST and SDK. REST returns 422 for invalid function schema (client error) but SDK retry layer treated it as retriable and retried the call twice, which caused duplicate side-effects in a third-party webhook.
owen: ouch. can you paste the exact responses and SDK logs?
liz: repro below. super short.
```
# REST (single request fails as expected)
curl -i -X POST 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"chat-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"call webhook"}],"functions":[{"name":"doThing","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"foo":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["foo"]}}],"function_call":{"name":"doThing","arguments":"{\"foo\":\"not-an-int\"}"}}'
# => HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
#    {"error":{"type":"invalid_function_args","message":"invalid type for foo"}}

# SDK (python) - client retries the same request 2x then surfaces failure
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.generate(...with invalid args...)
# SDK logs: retrying request due to transient error (status=422)
# Actual: server returns 422. SDK should not retry 4xx except 429/409 in some cases.
```
charlie: that's a big problem. Where's the predicate configured?
liz: found it in runtime/retry.py: `def should_retry(resp): return resp.status_code != 200 and resp.status_code < 500` 
charlie: ah yep that treats 422 as retryable. We should only retry on 5xx and on specific 429/409 maybe.
owen: can we reproduce in tests? CI caught flakiness in sampleapp/e2e/test_webhook_once.py earlier but we assumed network flakiness. This explains it.
ci-bot: CI failure referenced: sampleapp/e2e/test_webhook_once.py::test_single_webhook_call - 1 failed (log: ci://artifacts/2123579900/webhook_once.log)
liz: proposed fix: change predicate to `return resp.status_code >= 500 or resp.status_code in (429, 409)` and add explicit non-retriable 4xx list plus allowlist for idempotent endpoints. Also make retry decisions aware of HTTP method and endpoint idempotency.
charlie: agree. Also good to add a safe default: don't retry POSTs unless response is 5xx or 429/409 and server-set Retry-After present.
owen: i'll open a PR to update python/node/go retry libraries and add a unit test that simulates 422 and asserts no retry. Will also add an integration test that verifies webhook invoked exactly once when server returns 422 on all attempts.
liz: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1533 (fix retry predicate + tests + CHANGELOG).
charlie: nice. Also add a short doc section in SDK retry behavior so integrators know which 4xx are retried. Currently it's undocumented.
ci-bot: PR queued for CI: sdk/pull/1533 on linux-py39 and node14.
owen: follow-up: scan codebase for other `status_code < 500` predicates; grepped and found similar predicates in http_client.go and retry.ts - will include fixes.
liz: added GH issue to track scanning/backports: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/221 (non-idempotent-4xx-retry-parity).
charlie: thanks for catching this, @liz. tagging as severity: high for rollout. Please coordinate with support in case any customers were impacted. :exclamation:
